About: The world's past (History.cs). lore: Year (absolute) or YearsAgo, Month, Title, Place, Gang (faction id or null), Lines, When (text instead of a date). tales: per faction id, the raids / fights its men rode in - Kind RAID / CLASH / DUTY, Title with {place}, Places, Foe (faction id or null), HeardPercent, Line.

Lore.Title: The O'Driscoll - Van der Linde feud
Lines: Dutch van der Linde killed Colm O'Driscoll's brother; Colm killed Dutch's woman, Annabelle.
Neither man has forgotten - and neither gang lets the other ride past in peace.

Lore.Title: The Panic of '93
Lines: Banks fail from New York to Saint Denis; farms and stores go under by the hundred.

Lore.Title: Sisika Penitentiary fills up
Lines: The island prison takes every road agent and rustler the law can catch.

Lore.Title: The Lemoyne Raiders ride
Lines: Old Confederates who never laid down their arms ride the bayous and the fields, burning out northern money.

Lore.Title: Annesburg's coal
Lines: Men go down the mine poor and come up poorer.

Lore.Title: The Braithwaites and the Grays
Lines: Two old Scarlett Meadows families and an older feud - over land, over the war, over moonshine.

Lore.Title: Angelo Bronte's Saint Denis
Lines: Bronte's men run the docks, the saloons and half the police.

Lore.Title: Cornwall's railroad
Lines: Leviticus Cornwall's money lays track, drills oil and boils kerosene - and pays the men who do it in pennies.

Lore.Title: Night riders in Scarlett Meadows
Lines: Hooded fools burn crosses in the dark - and scatter the moment anyone shoots back.

Lore.Title: Fort Wallace
Lines: Colonel Henry Favours holds Ambarino for the Army; his patrols ride the Cumberland Forest roads.

Lore.Title: The Wapiti reservation
Lines: The Army hems the Wapiti onto their reservation - and oil men are already eyeing the land.

Lore.Title: Cattle money in Valentine
Lines: The stockyards are full and Smithfield's Saloon never closes.

Lore.Title: The Blackwater ferry job
Lines: The Van der Linde gang's robbery on the Blackwater ferry goes wrong - a woman is killed, and the gang runs for the mountains.
Pinkerton agents take the case; there's a price on every Van der Linde head.

odriscoll.Title: O'Driscolls hit a homestead near {place}
odriscoll.Line: They took the horses and whatever wasn't nailed down.

odriscoll.Title: Stagecoach robbed on the road to {place}
odriscoll.Line: The driver lived to tell the sheriff it was O'Driscolls.

odriscoll.Title: O'Driscolls and Van der Linde's men trade shots near {place}
odriscoll.Line: The old feud flares up again; both sides ride off cursing.

odriscoll.Title: O'Driscolls and Raiders fight over a moonshine run near {place}
Army patrol ambushed by O'Driscolls in {place}
odriscoll.Line: The Army swore it would be back with more men.

lemoyneraiders.Title: Raiders burn out a carpetbagger's store in {place}
lemoyneraiders.Line: They left a Union flag nailed to the door, burning.

lemoyneraiders.Title: Raiders and the Army trade fire in {place}
lemoyneraiders.Line: The soldiers held the road; the Raiders melted into the swamp.

lemoyneraiders.Title: Payroll wagon taken outside {place}
lemoyneraiders.Line: The guards were found tied to a tree, alive and furious.

lemoyneraiders.Title: Raiders run a Yankee surveyor out of {place}
lemoyneraiders.Line: His instruments are still at the bottom of the river.

army.Title: Army escorts a Cornwall payroll through {place}
army.Line: Not a shot fired - this time.

army.Title: Army column hunts O'Driscolls in {place}
army.Line: They burned an empty camp and two men's pride.

army.Title: Fort Wallace drills new recruits through the winter
army.Line: Half of them had never held a rifle.

wapiti.Title: Wapiti riders take back horses from an Army corral near {place}
wapiti.Line: They were gone before the bugle sounded. Nobody was hurt.

wapiti.Title: Soldiers and Wapiti trade arrows and bullets at {place}
wapiti.Line: Nobody would say who fired first.

wapiti.Title: A Wapiti hunting party rides out into {place}
wapiti.Line: Enough meat for the families, for a while.

klan.Title: Hooded riders burn a field in {place}
klan.Line: The farmer and his sons put the fire out by dawn.

klan.Title: A Klan rally broken up in {place} - the hoods ran
klan.Line: Somebody fired one shot. That was enough.

bronte.Title: Bronte's men lean on a shopkeeper in {place}
bronte.Line: He paid. The ones who don't pay find their windows broken.

bronte.Title: Bronte's men and the Lemoyne Raiders shoot it out over a shipment near {place}
bronte.Line: The crates went into the bayou. Both sides blamed the other.

bronte.Title: A dock foreman who talked to the papers is fished out of {place}
bronte.Line: The police called it an accident. Everyone knew better.

bronte.Title: Bronte's men take over a gambling house in {place}
bronte.Line: The old owner left town the same night.

murfree.Title: Travellers go missing on the road through {place}
murfree.Line: Their wagon was found. They weren't.

murfree.Title: The Brood drags a family off a homestead near {place}
murfree.Line: The bounty posters went up in Annesburg. Nobody went in after them.

murfree.Title: Murfrees and O'Driscolls cross paths in {place}
murfree.Line: The O'Driscolls didn't go back that way.

laramie.Title: Laramie boys run off a herd from {place}
laramie.Line: The brands were changed before the owners woke.

laramie.Title: Stagecoach held up on the road to {place}
laramie.Line: The driver said they laughed the whole time.

laramie.Title: Laramie men and Del Lobos shoot it out over stolen horses near {place}
Laramie rustlers and the Skinner Brothers cross paths in {place}
laramie.Line: The rustlers rode south the next morning.

laramie.Title: A rancher near {place} finds his herd wearing somebody else's brand
A stock detective found dead on the trail near {place}
laramie.Line: The cattlemen's association sent two more.

delobo.Title: Del Lobos rob a train near {place}
delobo.Line: They were back across the river before the marshal heard.

delobo.Title: A ranch outside {place} burned by the Del Lobos
delobo.Line: The rancher wouldn't pay. Now he has no ranch.

delobo.Title: Del Lobos and the Army trade shots in {place}
delobo.Line: The soldiers lost two men and the trail.

delobo.Title: Guns run across the river near {place}
delobo.Line: Nobody saw anything. Nobody ever does.

delobo.Title: The bank in {place} robbed in broad daylight
delobo.Line: The Del Lobos rode out shooting in the air.

delobo.Title: Del Lobos and rurales fight at the river near {place}
delobo.Line: The river ran with it for a day.

nightfolk.Title: A traveller vanishes on the bayou road near {place}
nightfolk.Line: His horse came home without him.

nightfolk.Title: Bodies found hanging in the cypress near {place}
nightfolk.Line: Nobody in Saint Denis would go and cut them down.

nightfolk.Title: Raiders ride into the swamp after the Night Folk near {place}
nightfolk.Line: Fewer rode out than rode in.

nightfolk.Title: Lanterns in the trees along the road near {place}, three nights running
nightfolk.Line: Nobody took that road after dark for a month.

nightfolk.Title: A fishing boat found drifting near {place}, nobody aboard
nightfolk.Line: The nets were cut. The lantern was still lit.

nightfolk.Title: A grave dug up in the night near {place}
nightfolk.Line: Whatever was taken, the family won't say.

nightfolk.Title: A Saint Denis family wakes to find something left on their doorstep
nightfolk.Line: They left the city within the week.

skinners.Title: A trapper's camp found stripped in {place}
skinners.Line: The Skinner Brothers' mark was cut into a tree beside it.

skinners.Title: Settlers scalped on the trail through {place}
skinners.Line: Blackwater put a price on the brothers' heads. Nobody collected.

skinners.Title: Skinner Brothers and bounty hunters fight in {place}
skinners.Line: Only one of the hunters rode out.
